summary.tldr: Lets certain tradespeople and apprentices deduct travel costs to distant construction job sites, starting with the 2022 tax year.
what_it_does: Creates a new Income Tax Act deduction for travel expenses to and from a construction job site that is at least 120 km from a worker's ordinary home.
Limits the deduction to duly qualified tradespersons and indentured apprentices who are working in construction.
Allows the deduction only if the worker had to pay the travel costs under the employment contract, did not get a non-taxable allowance for them, and does not claim them under another tax rule.
Applies the change to the 2022 and later taxation years.
summary.background: The bill adds a new travel expense deduction to subsection 8(1) of the Income Tax Act.
